Name: Advanced Beach Foraging
Author: stardewmoddingteen
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
This mod allows many more items to wash on the shore of the beach. The items include fish, ores, bars, trash and rare loot, so download to experience better beach foraging!

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
After unzipping the mod, place the folder named 'Advanced Beach Foraging' into your mods folder. Next, use CJB cheats to unlock all areas and give yourself all golden walnuts. Now you can start playing!

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
- You Can Find Multiple Species of Fish Washing On Shore (In Their Respective Seasons)
- Other Loot Which Includes:
Treasure Chests, Pearls, Bars and Ores of Different Materials and Trash


[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
The SMAPI mod and the Content Patcher mod are required for this mod.

[b][size=4]Disclaimer[/size][/b]
This mod has not been tested with other mods. While it should work fine on its own, using it alongside additional mods is at your own risk. Please backup your saves before using the mod if you are using additional mods. If you find that some mods are not functioning with this mod, please let me know through the 'post' section for this mod.

[b]Shoutouts[/b]
A huge thank you to everyone playing with this mod!
